checks.name: TEXT/DM attachment viewer markup and protected URLs
checks.observation: SSR tests cover the image-open control, named viewer dialog, same-origin channel and DM preview paths, separate original download action, and non-raster download-only fallback. Additional source-contract tests check Escape/close/focus return, same-origin no-store loading, 404/410 handling, object-URL cleanup and narrow viewport bounds.

checks.observation: vue-tsc and Vite production build passed. Vite printed the existing informational warning about the LiveKit chunk exceeding 500 kB.

checks.name: Authenticated browser/device acceptance
checks.reason: No authenticated user fixture was available. Escape/focus return, actual protected image loading/ACL denial, responsive sizing and matched Flutter/browser screenshots need a real browser/device pass.

privacy: The viewer fetches only the existing protected preview URL using same-origin credentials and no-store caching; object URLs are revoked when the viewer closes or unmounts. Original files remain behind a separate explicit download link.
remaining: Verify a real TEXT attachment and participant-only DM attachment, including denied/removed cases, focus return and narrow mobile layout; compare against the Flutter viewer.
